# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Path and glyph rendering fixes**

## Highlights

The upcoming 4.156 update improves native path rasterization, glyph replay validation, and Graphite readback. These same-milestone fixes leave managed wrappers, generated bindings, and package version inputs unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Clipped paths and coverage masks** — Corrects Ganesh device-space path bounds and coverage-mask subset clamping, plus Graphite clip keys and wedge miter bounds. Convex antialiased rasterization also gains buffer-overflow and fixed-point arithmetic guards; those raster guards are disabled in custom builds defining SK_LEGACY_ALPHA_RUNS. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
- **Validated glyph replay** — Validates serialized Slug positions, transforms, bounds, and flags, bounds direct-mask offsets, and preserves creation-time float rounding during replay. Unsuitable glyph data retains rendering fallbacks, including when glyph-atlas bilinear filtering is unavailable. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624))
- **Complete Graphite readback pixels** — Corrects pixel-size and row-stride handling for GPU-to-CPU transfers from alpha textures to RGBx destinations, ensuring every destination pixel bit is written with opaque output. ([#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
